about: Parts washer, self-made in Blender (sources/washer/build_washer.py) from photos of drum-mounted solvent washers (Graymills DMS336A class, Penn Tool Co. listing) and the record: a 30-gal drum with rolling hoops and chimes, the tapered adapter, the 34 x 22 in sink with its rolled rim, back splash, parts grate, drain strainer and a pool of solvent, the flexible spigot, the pump's switch box and cord, a warning label, and the lid propped open on its fusible-link stay. Where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.parts_washer) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled against washer photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked
